text: Ko Allah tun heeranii laamagol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin. Himo haforana junuubi mo O muuyani e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, O naada ontigi Aljanna; Himo leptira kadi nunɗal Makko ngal, mo O muuyani e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Allah siforii wonnde Haforoowo junuubi kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
